title: Woman at the Threshold
description: A woman in a dark coat and peach satin dress stands in a decaying arched doorway, her right hand touching a heavily damaged yellow door covered in purple lightning-like cracks, old photos, and graffiti reading 'Geburt' and 'Gehalt'. The derelict interior features peeling paint, scattered debris, broken objects and a fluorescent light above the doorway revealing a shadowy figure in the background room.
prompt: A mysterious woman wearing a dark overcoat and a flowing peach satin dress stands at the threshold of a decaying arched doorway, reaching toward a heavily damaged yellow door covered in purple energy cracks, taped photographs, and graffiti. The surrounding walls are covered in peeling paint and colorful abstract murals. Debris, broken objects, and red fabric litter the cracked floor. A fluorescent light flickers above. Moody cinematic lighting, painterly digital art style.
